headline: BlackRock files for a bitcoin ETF with downside protection

scenes.vo: The biggest bitcoin ETF issuer just filed for a fund built to limit your losses. Here's what changed.
BlackRock filed with the SEC on Monday for a new fund, the Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF. It would use options on its bitcoin trust to cap losses at about ten percent, before fees.
Here's why traders are watching it. A loss floor could appeal to cautious investors who have avoided bitcoin's big swings.
The catch. Your upside is capped, the protection resets in stages, and this is only a filing. It could not launch before early next year.
Here's what happens next. Watch for the final fee, the size of the upside cap, and whether rivals file similar bitcoin funds.
